caption: The drawing is on a beige-colored paper and consists of three main black line illustrations of a table with annotations specifying measurements. In the upper left, there is a side elevation view of the table, showing a rectangular tabletop supported by two turned legs, which connect to three curving legs at the base; the feet are curled, and the lower connect point is illustrated with vertical slats. Directly to the right is a larger side view, showing the table with one leaf open, represented by dashed lines and labeled as "OPEN TOP"; the detailed inner structure of the table is visible, with vertical measurements marked for the legs (26 3/4 inches from foot to tabletop, 16 1/4 inches for the height of the open top). The base dimensions and parts of the table’s mechanics are notated with precise fractions of inches, and the segmented parts are rendered with straight and curved lines. Below, there is a top-down outline labeled “TOP OF TABLE,” showing a rounded corner on the right side and straight edges on the other sides. At the upper right, the drawing lists the table’s total "HEIGHT - 2' 6 3/4", WIDTH - 1' 6 1/4", LENGTH - 3'," and in the bottom right corner, the date “4/23/36," the label “FEDERAL-BLBG,” the scale "1/8 in = 1 in," and the signature “JACK CARR” are written. Handwritten text and measurement annotations appear in both horizontal and vertical orientations throughout the drawing.
title: Card Table
